summary: B30 Pro Workspace admin frontend + user entry, B31 Data Governance/Privacy (backend + frontend + reauth), and B32 Home Dashboard + Timeline (backend + frontend) all validated end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest pass (100%). Frontend web (mobile viewport 390x844 for user, 1280x900 for admin): all critical testIDs render and integrate with backend. B31 reauth security confirmed (403 without X-Reauth-Token, 401 on wrong password, 400 on unknown action, one-time token enforced, action-mismatch rejected). Account-deletion reauth modal was opened and cancelled — demo account NOT deleted. Export flow with password reauth → export ready end-to-end. B32 dashboard renders snapshot + Homie AI summary + 2 attention items (safety = Acknowledge) + stat grid + coverage bar; timeline renders events + filter chips + add/delete note. B30 admin: pro-toggle-enabled/pro-toggle-approve settings PUT works, 4 professionals with approve/suspend actions rendered. B31 admin: dashboard counters, retention policies (6), incident create + status-advance to resolved verified.

issues: Required consents (Terms, Privacy Policy) render as OFF/grey Switches for demo_home. They are marked Required so the UX is confusing — users may think they haven't accepted the terms. Consider defaulting required consents to granted at account creation OR visually locking them in the ON state with a distinct required badge (currently just the label suffix).

action_items: OPTIONAL/NON-BLOCKING: On account creation, seed required consents (terms, privacy_policy) to status=granted so they display as ON on /home-intel/privacy. Alternatively, in privacy.tsx, force `value={true}` for c.required consents so the visual state matches the semantic 'Required' state.

OPTIONAL: The Switch `disabled` prop for required consents is applied at React level but does not always propagate to a DOM `disabled` attribute on web (aria-disabled also missing). Consider adding aria-disabled={c.required} explicitly for accessibility/testing.
critical_code_review_comments: B31 reauth security enforcement is well-implemented in data_governance_engine.py: X-Reauth-Token consumed via one-time use, action-bound, TTL-limited. Password re-verification uses pwd_context.verify (bcrypt) — good separation from JWT bearer.

B31 export categories filtered against server-side EXPORT_CATEGORIES whitelist — no injection risk. Download token is 24-byte urlsafe, hashed at rest (secure_token=_digest(token)); only the plaintext is returned once, and downloads are TTL+identity-bound. Good.
B32 dashboard_engine snapshot/attention/timeline all use user_id filter — no cross-user leakage. Timeline note create+delete round-trip verified (id returned; visible in list; removed after delete).

Admin nav testID keys are distinct (admin-nav-proworkspace, admin-nav-datagovernance) and don't collide with pre-existing admin-nav-notifications / admin-nav-notiforch / admin-nav-compliance from prior iterations.

data_governance_engine.build_admin_router prefix is `/api/hi/admin/privacy` while frontend nav labels it 'Data Governance' with testID `admin-nav-datagovernance`. That mismatch is intentional (URL space = privacy; UI = Data Governance) but easy to trip on for future work — worth a comment in the engine.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all critical testIDs across HI entry tiles (hi-dashboard, hi-pro-workspace, hi-privacy), /home-intel/dashboard (dash-summary-toggle, dash-timeline, dash-ask, dash-dismiss-*), /home-intel/timeline (tl-filter-*, tl-add-note, tl-note-title, tl-note-save, tl-del-*), /home-intel/privacy (privacy-consent-*, privacy-analytics, privacy-ai-training, privacy-cat-*, privacy-export, privacy-reauth-pw, privacy-reauth-confirm, privacy-delete-account), /pro-workspace (pro-new-project, pro-project-*), /admin (admin-nav-proworkspace, admin-nav-datagovernance) plus ProWorkspaceModule (pro-toggle-enabled/approve, pro-approve-*/suspend-*) and DataGovernanceModule (dg-incident-type, dg-sev-*, dg-incident-create, dg-inc-invest-*/resolve-*)
